courses.overview: 從避雷器能量、保護距離與絕緣裕度延伸至相近領域；相似物理不代表同一設備規格或驗收程序。
courses.overviewEn: Extend arrester energy, protective distance and insulation margins to neighboring domains; shared physics does not imply identical equipment requirements or acceptance procedures.

related.title: 氣體絕緣開關設備
related.why: 介電承受與保護電壓需匹配
related.whyEn: Withstand and protection levels must match
related.transfer: 介電承受與保護電壓需匹配
related.transferEn: Withstand and protection levels must match
related.difference: GIS 的快速暫態有額外傳播效應
related.differenceEn: GIS fast transients add propagation effects
practice: 以「過電壓種類」為起點，畫出本課與「氣體絕緣開關設備」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「GIS 的快速暫態有額外傳播效應」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from overvoltage types and mark shared/redefined boundaries with gas-insulated switchgear.
For the difference "GIS fast transients add propagation effects", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.

practiceEn: Start from overvoltage types and mark shared/redefined boundaries with high-voltage cable insulation and joints.
